1:
Oh my~ Sensei, is there something you
need~? I'm a little busy right now~
2:
You doing something...? Er, I mean, are you
doing something?
5:
(I-it's okay! The jamming is perfect! I'm the
teacher! She sees a teacher!)
6:
And what business might you have with
Sakurai?
7:
Nothing important~ I'm just planning
another event~
9:
Ah, a school event. Something like that
sounds fine, doesn't it?
10: An obstacle race where you risk your life~
12:
Why should I have to risk my life in an
obstacle race?!
13:
Oh my~ Sensei, you don't have to take
part, you know~? Not that I'd stop you~
14:
Ah! That's right. The teacher doesn't have
to take part.
15:
That's right~ The only one who'd want to
take part is probably Sakurai-kun~?
16: (Like hell I would! I'm never taking part!)
17:
Jumping through rings of fire~ Crossing a
balance beam 30 meters up~
21:
Absolutely not! There's no way something
that dangerous is allowed!
22: Oh my~ Opposing what the President does...
23:
I never thought there'd be a teacher like
that~
28: There's no way you could hear that!
29:
(Crap... At this rate, she'll see through
me?!)
30:
L-listen up! No! Anything life-threatening is
absolutely forbidden!
33:
(It's no use! No matter what I say, I feel
like she'll see through me!! I've gotta run!!)
36:
Yeah, I think it'd be fun, that obstacle
race.
37: (I mean, all I have to do is not take part!)
38:
Is that so~? Hmm, maybe it was too
ordinary~?
39:
I'm kind of bored of it now. Maybe I'll think
up a different event~
41:
An event that's even more gruesome and
impossible to escape would be more fun,
wouldn't it~?
42:
(Her thinking just took a turn for the
worse?!)
43: The President will do her best~
45:
(At this rate, I'm gonna get put through
hell...)
47:
Then how about this? Like, a bread-eating
race.
48:
Oh my~ A bread-eating race sounds fun
too, doesn't it~?
52:
That's right~ Out of every six buns, one
will be poisoned~
54:
And you can't cross the finish line until
you've eaten all six~
55: Then you're guaranteed to eat the poison!!
57:
Nobody can eat that many in the first
place! And that's not even a race anymore,
is it?!
58:
I'm sure Sakurai-kun would be delighted to
take part~
60:
What if the winner gets a mixed hot spring
bath with a bunch of pretty girls~?
61:
Hm. ...Now that's a brilliant idea! I bet
Sakurai would be delighted to take part.
62:
But actually, I'll put poison in all of them~
That way I'm sure to hear some lovely
screams~
63:
(So no matter what, I'm getting put through
hell...)
